limitations: All evidence is from Microsoft Planetary Computer collection metadata and the linked Microsoft dataset overview URLs; no items or data assets were fetched.
STAC bbox and temporal interval are declarations and can be envelope-level or incomplete; collection descriptions and provider terms require review.
Native format declarations and Azure storage paths do not establish downloadability, authorization, checksum integrity, or byte-level COG/Zarr/NetCDF/GeoParquet conformance.
No citation metrics collected. Candidate suggestions do not change canonical records.
review_method: Metadata-only review of captured current collection records; world-scale descriptions and STAC bounds are combined. A world bbox alone does not qualify coverage. Native asset declarations are reuse signals, not validated downloads. DOI is emitted only when present in collection description.
source_retention_note: Source inventory reproduces from normalized retained metadata with two signed-thumbnail query credentials removed. Manifest distinguishes original response digest/bytes from retained body digest/bytes; no original raw-response replay claim.
